mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of a recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for three consecutive months, or the signal fails to generate a negative return in 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and personal consumption expenditures (as proxied by RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 94.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts above 610,000 units in a single month signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand for durable goods, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% over a 3-month window triggers expectations of tighter monetary policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% yoy, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment growth (PAYEMS) and a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to predict positive SPX 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (as proxied by RSAFS) combined with a contraction in GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a weakening demand environment, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and GDPC1 fails to predict negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
